strings.The request timed out: raise --timeout (: The request timed out: raise --timeout (and --max-request-time for long answers) and re-run.
strings.The relay rate-limited the request (HTTP: The relay rate-limited the request (HTTP 429): lower --concurrency or wait for the limit to reset, then re-run.
strings.The endpoint rejected the request (HTTP: The endpoint rejected the request (HTTP 400/422), often a parameter it does not support for this model: check the error text and re-run.
strings.The endpoint refused the key (HTTP 401/4: The endpoint refused the key (HTTP 401/403): check the API key and its access to this model, then re-run.
strings.The endpoint or model was not found (HTT: The endpoint or model was not found (HTTP 404): check --base-url and --model, then re-run.
strings.The relay or its upstream failed (HTTP 5: The relay or its upstream failed (HTTP 5xx): re-run later; if it keeps failing, the relay is unstable for this model.
strings.The request never reached the relay (pro: The request never reached the relay (proxy, DNS, connect or TLS failure): check the network path and --base-url, then re-run.
strings.The request failed inside ekte, not at t: The request failed inside ekte, not at the relay: re-run; if it persists, report it with the evidence file.
strings.This client has no such endpoint for the: This client has no such endpoint for the configured wire protocol: check --api for this relay.
strings.The relay answered without usable conten: The relay answered without usable content: check that it serves this model and returns its text, then re-run.
strings.The request failed at the relay: check t: The request failed at the relay: check the error text and re-run.
strings.The relay sent no streamed content delta: The relay sent no streamed content deltas, so there is no time to first token: it does not stream this model's answers (see the Streaming findings). Fix streaming at the relay, or re-run with --performance-non-streaming to measure end-to-end throughput instead.
strings.The answers were too short to time decod: The answers were too short to time decoding (fewer than 2 tokens after the first): check that the model answers the probe with text and that the relay does not cut it off.
strings.Most probe requests failed, so too few w: Most probe requests failed, so too few were left to judge: fix the failures shown under Probe request failures, then re-run.
strings.Most probe requests came back from a cac: Most probe requests came back from a cache and were left out: audit a relay without response caching, or ask its operator to disable it for this key, then re-run.
strings.The standard suite sends only 5 probe re: The standard suite sends only 5 probe requests per endpoint, fewer than consistency needs: run the deep, full or custom suite to judge it.
strings.Too few probe requests were sent: raise: Too few probe requests were sent: raise --performance-requests to at least 10 and re-run.
strings.The relay's responses carry no model fie: The relay's responses carry no model field, so it cannot be compared with the requested model; nothing to change on your side, the other identity findings still apply.
strings.The relay returns no usage.prompt_tokens: The relay returns no usage.prompt_tokens, so a hidden system prompt cannot be measured: ask its operator to forward the upstream usage block, then re-run.
strings.The model did not repeat the canaries wo: The model did not repeat the canaries word for word, so substitution could not be checked: re-run, and if it persists audit with a model that follows copy instructions.
strings.The probe cap is below the probe floor:: The probe cap is below the probe floor: raise --max-context-tokens above context_probe_floor_tokens (1000 by default), or check the declared context window, then re-run.
strings.No identity probe got a usable answer: f: No identity probe got a usable answer: fix the failures shown in the identity findings (or under Connectivity) and re-run, or run ekte compare against a trusted baseline.
strings.Nothing to change: this probe is skipped: Nothing to change: this probe is skipped by design to keep the identity check's output small, and another probe takes its place.
strings.The judge call failed or its answer coul: The judge call failed or its answer could not be parsed: check --judge-base-url, --judge-model and --judge-api-key, then re-run.
strings.The judge could not decide from these an: The judge could not decide from these answers: re-run, or weigh the fingerprint and self-identification findings instead.
strings.Not run in this suite: its checks run on: Not run in this suite: its checks run on the standard suite or higher.
strings.Not run in this suite: on the standard s: Not run in this suite: on the standard suite its checks need a trusted baseline (ekte compare); the deep, full and custom suites run them without one.
strings.Not run in this suite: its checks run on: Not run in this suite: its checks run on the deep, full or custom suite.
Not run in this suite: its checks run on the full suite only.
strings.Not run: its checks need an LLM judge (-: Not run: its checks need an LLM judge (--judge with --judge-model).
strings.Not run: its checks are switched off in: Not run: its checks are switched off in the configuration.
strings.Set --performance-requests above 0 (10 o: Set --performance-requests above 0 (10 or more to judge consistency) to run the probe.
strings.{samples} clean samples of {requests} pr: {samples} clean samples of {requests} probe requests ({failed} failed, {cached} cached, {missing} without a usable value); too few to judge consistency.
